analysis_frame.scope: Excluding one of two identical printed ten-coordinate blocks, then one further coordinate. Both duplicate locations and all remaining one-coordinate exclusions are compared; the primary frame is one explicit representative.

records.readable_german: Auskunft ueber Schicksal Heeresangehoeriger in Baku erbeten. Kriegsministerium, Abteilung fuer verbuendete Heere. Nr ????STRICHA?. Geh. A W.
records.meaning: The proposed reading requests information on the fate of army personnel in Baku and gives the War Ministry department for allied armies as sender. The telegram itself does not identify particular individuals or explain their fate.
notes: The source prints 279 body slots against an advertised 268. Its final row repeats the identical ten-coordinate block XFVVF DXXVG. One occurrence and one further coordinate are excluded only in the conditional analysis frame.
The invalid E in XGVEX is preserved literally and masked in the raw frame; the proposed S in AUSKUNFT fills it with F.
The full word proposal costs ten observed-coordinate substitutions and one source-mask fill in addition to eleven excluded observed coordinates.
Both minimum-cost final-coordinate choices retain the same displayed raw and edited strings but give different equality relations for the last unknown reference symbol; neither is discarded.

prior_credit: Published period keys: George Lasry, Ingo Niebel, Nils Kopal and Arno Wacker (2016), and George Lasry (2017 key list). Earlier repository OCR is retained. Source review and explicit reconstruction: icekylinx and GPT-6 Astra Pro. No universal first-decipherment priority is asserted.
limits: The duplicated-block and extra-coordinate exclusions are conditional source operations, not free corrections to OCR and not source-visible cancellations.
The edit-price comparison fixes one proposed letter pattern, leaves its question marks unconstrained, and covers only the declared exclusion family.
The two remaining reference equality patterns are not merged or resolved by language plausibility.
The historical fate of the people mentioned is not established by a request for information.
